deckTitle: 17 Kayfabe-Questions from Socrates to the FBI

cards.power: Unlocks 2500 years of parallel psychological evolution.
cards.lore: Socrates, trial lawyers, and cult leaders stumbled upon the exact same hack independently.
cards.gradeReason: Conceptual opener — primes the table but doesn't hand you the move yet.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Ancient tortoise detective pinning conspiracy string on corkboard. Mood: Ominous scholarly.

cards.power: Delivers the invisible mental structure without ever pushing a position.
cards.lore: The specific words change every single time, but the underlying structure never does.
cards.gradeReason: Meta-framework card — explains what you're building, not what to do right now.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Beaver laying glowing blueprint bricks into someone's skull. Mood: Clinical and sinister.

cards.power: Forces the target's neurology to finish your job.
cards.lore: You create the conditions; their own brain does the persuading, deciding, and surrendering.
cards.gradeReason: Instantly playable role — you know exactly what you're NOT doing (arguing).
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Spider setting clockwork trap while hypnotized fly walks in voluntarily. Mood: Patient predatory.

cards.power: Deploys the target's own mind to ruthlessly enforce their new reality.
cards.lore: A brain that adopts your reality will police it from the inside better than you ever could.
cards.gradeReason: Bulldog-with-badge image locks the role in instantly — you become the outsourced sheriff.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Bulldog sheriff inside glass brain enforcing invisible rules. Mood: Eerie bureaucratic authority.

cards.power: Establishes a position they hold, then asks why they don't hold a weaker one.
cards.lore: The only way to answer is to fiercely defend the stronger position, which is secretly yours.
cards.gradeReason: Crystal-clear judo move — you set the trap, they snap it shut on themselves.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Opossum holding mirror showing stronger version of itself arguing fiercely. Mood: Smug reversalist.

cards.power: Demands the conditions under which a brutal decision requires zero thought.
cards.lore: Every single response builds a path forward on a map they draw themselves.
cards.gradeReason: Powerful tactic but requires framing setup before you can deploy it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Octopus drawing labyrinth map while target reads it aloud. Mood: Tentacular inevitability.

cards.power: Embeds a predetermined conclusion directly into the grammar of a casual question.
cards.lore: Their brain constructs a moment of clarity out of thin air just to make the sentence compute.
cards.gradeReason: Elegant mechanic but needs one example sentence to click into performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Vulture asking innocent question while hidden conclusion assembles in speech bubble. Mood: Casually devastating.

cards.power: Shrinks a massive barrier by forcing them to name their one specific fear.
cards.lore: Naming a fear instantly strips its power, clearing the path forward.
cards.gradeReason: Name alone conjures the move — the fairy-tale logic clicks before you even read the lore.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Skunk pointing at tiny labeled monster that just deflated. Mood: Triumphant ridiculous.

cards.power: Flips a 3/10 will-to-live into a desperate, immediate argument for survival.
cards.lore: Defending against a lower number forces them to list every reason their life actually matters.
cards.gradeReason: Literal script you speak right now — three words, catastrophic effect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Groundhog on cliff suddenly arguing furiously at a number 2 sign below. Mood: Urgent absurd reversal.

cards.cardName: WHAT WOULD NEED TO BE TRUE... ?
cards.power: Forces them to describe an alternate reality where the painful choice feels obvious.
cards.lore: You bypass the hard decision entirely by asking them to paint the easy one.
cards.gradeReason: Verbatim incantation — you say these exact words and step back.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Owl with enormous glasses studying map of alternate futures the target drew. Mood: Scholarly inevitability.

cards.cardName: JUST ONE THING STANDING IN THE WAY.
cards.power: Distills a mountain of vague resistance into a single, destroyable target.
cards.lore: If this one thing is handled, the massive invisible barrier shrinks to nothing.
cards.gradeReason: Armored rhino smashing one brick — the image is the instruction.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Armored rhino charging through wall of fog to reach single red brick. Mood: Focused annihilation.

cards.power: Injects three hidden presuppositions into one innocent-sounding inquiry.
cards.lore: They will eagerly hallucinate a profound realization that didn't even exist five seconds ago.
cards.gradeReason: Triple presupposition masterwork — you ask it, they invent the answer and believe it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Woodpecker drilling three presuppositions into gear-brain while target nods with light bulb appearing. Mood: Mechanical epiphany.

cards.power: Names their emotional state accurately before they find the word for it themselves.
cards.lore: Every unnamed emotion controls you; a labeled emotion just sits quietly in the corner.
cards.gradeReason: Color-shifting chameleon — you name it first, it loses its grip.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Chameleon painting emotion labels on target's chest before target looks down. Mood: Precise disarming.

cards.power: Re-categorizes aggressive fighting emotions into vulnerable, softening emotions.
cards.lore: 99% of people cannot tell anger from hurt when their blood is pumping.
cards.gradeReason: Elegant mechanic but requires knowing which category to move them into.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Sloth calmly holding golden frame around burning aggression that softens into tears. Mood: Serene alchemy.

cards.power: Proves to their nervous system that another human genuinely sees what they carry.
cards.lore: The moment a person feels truly seen, the internal war is instantly over.
cards.gradeReason: Meerkat peering through rubble — witnessing is the action; you know exactly what to do.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Meerkat looking through brick wall into target's chest with genuine wide-eyed recognition. Mood: Disarming tenderness.

cards.power: Acknowledges an unspoken truth and calmly declares that you can handle it.
cards.lore: Making silence heavier than the truth extracts the confession without an interrogation.
cards.gradeReason: The move is clear but execution demands exact emotional calibration.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Pigeon carrying sealed envelope into room while target's hand slowly reaches to intercept it. Mood: Weighted inevitability.

cards.power: Defuses outward rage by surgically relabeling it as inward pain.
cards.lore: Anger wants to fight, but hurt just softens up and needs to be heard.
cards.gradeReason: Three words. That's it. You say these and the armor comes off.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Porcupine with spines slowly lowering after hearing three words float by. Mood: Unexpected deflation.

cards.cardName: NOBODY'S EVER SAID THAT OUT LOUD TO YOU.
cards.power: Validates a lonely lifetime of quietly carrying heavy burdens for others.
cards.lore: When you perfectly describe someone's unspoken history, they hand you the keys to the vault.
cards.gradeReason: Speak this sentence once. The elephant-carrying-anvil image is the permission slip to feel it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Elephant carrying giant anvil finally stopping as someone looks it directly in the eye. Mood: Lifetime-weight released.

cards.power: Projects pure unshakeable strength so they feel safe unloading their worst secret.
cards.lore: It's not a soft "you are safe", it's a structural "I am unbreakable."
cards.gradeReason: Armadillo in armor — say it, they unload immediately.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Armadillo uncurling calmly from armored ball while secrets float toward it. Mood: Structural unbreakable calm.

cards.power: Frames the silent thing in the room as the only thing that actually matters.
cards.lore: An untargeted, Socratic observation makes them volunteer the truth instead of you extracting it.
cards.gradeReason: Say this. Stop talking. Watch the diamond appear in the swan's beak.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Swan holding glowing diamond in silence while target leans forward to fill the void. Mood: Pregnant Socratic pause.

cards.power: Hijacks the brain stem while the victim remains entirely blind to its control.
cards.lore: Moving the feeling to the cortex changes it from a master to a captive you can observe.
cards.gradeReason: Neuroscience framing needs one beat of translation before it becomes performable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Lizard-brained creature controlling larger body from hidden brain-stem cockpit. Mood: Invisible puppet architecture.

cards.power: Triggers a half-second facial softening as the defensive mask involuntarily drops.
cards.lore: What you do in that fraction of a second defines who you are as a human being.
cards.gradeReason: You need to know what to watch for first — once you do, it's a G1 unlock.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Blobfish's armor-face flickering open for half a second revealing vulnerability underneath. Mood: Blink-and-miss-it window.

cards.power: Shuts down the prefrontal filter because the brain suddenly registers safety.
cards.lore: You cannot trick this switch; genuine witnessing bypasses all security systems automatically.
cards.gradeReason: Concept card — you need to understand what it is before you can operate it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Koala operating control panel switching off security monitor labeled 'prefrontal filter'. Mood: Technical override ceremony.

cards.power: Explicitly authorizes them to want what they have been denying themselves for years.
cards.lore: The obligation wasn't real; they were just waiting for another human to say it's okay.
cards.gradeReason: Golden retriever with Permission Granted certificate — you know exactly what to hand over.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Golden retriever solemnly presenting notarized permission slip to tearful target. Mood: Long-waited absolution.

cards.power: Peels off a negative label and slaps on a new one that serves the target.
cards.lore: The story around the feeling is the only thing that was ever driving the behavior.
cards.gradeReason: Hermit crab swapping shells — immediate, tactile, you know what to grab and replace.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Hermit crab dropping rusty shame-shell and sliding into gleaming new identity-shell. Mood: Liberating swap.

cards.power: Points at an existing quality so accurately that they cannot resist claiming it.
cards.lore: Nobody on earth resists being accurately recognized for their hidden greatness.
cards.gradeReason: Peacock in mirror — you name the feather, they fan it wide and walk in.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Peacock fanning feathers in mirror as tiny bird points excitedly at the exact right feather. Mood: Irresistible recognition.

cards.power: Assigns them a safe, negative trait they are forced to desperately disprove.
cards.lore: Disproving your strategic accusation makes them act exactly how you wanted them to.
cards.gradeReason: Platypus digging out of accusation-mud — mechanic is clear but requires setup.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Platypus furiously proving it can swim after being told it probably can't. Mood: Desperate self-refutation.

cards.power: Expresses genuine surprise that their hesitation doesn't match their known bravery.
cards.lore: They must close the gap by acting immediately, or suffer a permanently diminished identity.
cards.gradeReason: Kangaroo with identity-crack in ground — you express the surprise and step back.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Kangaroo staring at crack in ground between who they are and what they're doing. Mood: Identity crisis in one frame.

cards.power: RE-FILES A CRIPPLING PANIC ATTACK AS A HEROIC BIOLOGICAL SIGNAL THAT SOMETHING MATTERS.
cards.lore: SAME PHYSICAL INPUT, BUT A COMPLETELY DIFFERENT BEHAVIORAL PROTOCOL OF ENGAGEMENT.
cards.gradeReason: Three-word refile of panic into power — speak it, watch the cheetah stop shaking.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Cheetah surrounded by coffee cups twitching, snapping into predator stance on hearing the phrase. Mood: Biological reclassification.

cards.cardName: HAS THAT ALWAYS BEEN A THING?
cards.power: RECOGNIZES THEIR HIDDEN STEADINESS AND IMPLIES IT HAS DEEP, MEANINGFUL ROOTS.
cards.lore: THEY WILL INSTANTLY VOLUNTEER THE REST OF THE STORY AND LOCK THEMSELVES IN.
cards.gradeReason: Iguana in golden light nods and suddenly can't stop talking — perfect lock-in script.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Iguana sitting in sunlight as past narrative floods in visible as glowing roots below. Mood: Rooted recognition.

cards.cardName: PROBABLY NOT THE KIND OF PERSON.
cards.power: ACCUSES THEM OF PLAYING IT SAFE SO THEY IMPULSIVELY BET IT ALL JUST TO PROVE YOU WRONG.
cards.lore: THEY HAND YOU A TOTAL CONFESSION OF THEIR TRUE DECISION-MAKING PROCESS.
cards.gradeReason: Racing sloth with number 1 bib — the reverse-psychology is so clean it burns clean.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Sloth in racing gear betting everything furiously while looking at skeptical observer. Mood: Enraged self-exposure.

cards.cardName: SURPRISED YOU'RE STILL THINKING ABOUT THIS.
cards.power: INSTANTLY FRACTURES THEIR HESITATION BY FRAMING IT AS A WEIRD GLITCH IN THEIR CHARACTER.
cards.lore: HESITATION BECOMES INCONSISTENT WITH WHO THEY ARE, FORCING AN IMMEDIATE ACTION TO FIX IT.
cards.gradeReason: Deer in spotlight surrounded by flying gears — say this and watch the glitch resolve itself.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Deer frozen in spotlight with gears flying around skull breaking formation as observer's eyebrow raises. Mood: Hesitation caught on camera.

cards.power: Gives them a socially acceptable out that they will actively refuse to take.
cards.lore: Giving them space to disagree makes them volunteer to stay in the uncomfortable zone.
cards.gradeReason: Honey badger shouting at a rock — you open the door, they refuse to leave.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Honey badger given wide-open exit door, turning its back to it furiously and digging in. Mood: Stubborn self-imprisonment.

cards.power: Forces a brutal choice between taking action or admitting they are fundamentally weak.
cards.lore: Most people would rather leap blindly into the dark than confirm they are a coward.
cards.gradeReason: Lion seeing small cat in mirror — devastating but requires precise framing setup.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Lion looking in cracked mirror that shows nervous house cat. Forced choice crystallizing. Mood: Existential no-exit.

cards.power: Opens a mental cycle that cannot be resolved through mere thinking.
cards.lore: The only way out of this psychological loop is through immediate physical commitment.
cards.gradeReason: Ouroboros snake is perfectly apt but you need to know what loop to open.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Snake eating own tail while tiny mouse holds up sign: ONLY DOOR = ACTION. Mood: Infinite loop with single exit.

cards.power: Asks them to articulate their highest value as if it's mere self-reflection.
cards.lore: Their own neurology will enforce their stated value ruthlessly when the moment arrives.
cards.gradeReason: Beetle with vault door — you ask the question, their own brain becomes the enforcer.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Rhinoceros beetle turning vault dial while target's brain inside watches, memorizing the combination. Mood: Self-sealing mechanism.

cards.power: Draws a circle around two people and leaves the entire world on the outside.
cards.lore: The strongest bonding mechanism is shared access to a truth most people aren't ready for.
cards.gradeReason: Huddle of meerkats — you lean in, lower your voice, draw the circle. Instantly done.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Two meerkats huddled in glowing chalk circle with entire world rendered tiny outside. Mood: Intimate conspiratorial warmth.

cards.power: Completely erases the logistical frame and replaces it with a massive identity crisis.
cards.lore: Identity will beat logistics one hundred percent of the time, with absolutely no exceptions.
cards.gradeReason: Radioactive egg in nest — striking image but the mechanic needs a beat to operationalize.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Bird returning to nest to find glowing radioactive egg replacing old one, identity crisis spreading. Mood: Replacement reality hatching.

cards.power: Kicks the calculating adult offline by activating a highly specific childhood memory.
cards.lore: Anything you say to the regressed state lands deeper than the armored adult could ever block.
cards.gradeReason: Bear with teddy bear is evocative but deploying regression precisely requires skill.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Adult bear suddenly clutching tiny teddy bear as armored adult-mode flickers off and words float in unobstructed. Mood: Armor-bypassing regression.

cards.power: Ties the terror of not deciding to the grief of giving up a future memory.
cards.lore: You bypass the hypothetical by building a concrete, sensory morning-after in their mind.
cards.gradeReason: Walrus fortune-teller building a real morning in the crystal ball — vivid, immediate deployment.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Walrus in turban showing crystal ball where target wakes up having already decided, sun rising real and specific. Mood: Concrete future grief.

cards.power: Instantly inducts them into a high-status secret society of exactly two people.
cards.lore: They will agree to absolutely anything just to prove they aren't like "most people".
cards.gradeReason: Fox with velvet rope — say it, step back, watch them vault the barrier.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Fox in top hat lifting velvet rope for single target while crowd watches enviously. Mood: Exclusion operating at maximum ego pull.

cards.power: Flips the negotiation from APR percentages to a definitive statement about who they are.
cards.lore: If it's about money, they bargain. If it's about their soul, they surrender.
cards.gradeReason: Raccoon burning cash — the reframe is the line itself. Speak it. Done.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Raccoon throwing bills into bonfire as negotiation table melts revealing identity mirror. Mood: Money evaporating into character test.

cards.cardName: The first time somebody believed in you.
cards.power: Forces them to remember the non-polite, visceral feeling of being truly seen.
cards.lore: The scent of that memory bypasses every single defense they brought into the room.
cards.gradeReason: Pelican catching golden fish — you speak this and every defense dissolves instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Pelican catching glowing fish while target's armor-layer melts into tears. Memory floating visible behind them. Mood: Primal defense bypass.

cards.power: Transports their brain into a vivid, sensory future where the deed is already done.
cards.lore: The brain cannot process a hypothetical when you construct a concrete morning.
cards.gradeReason: Rooster at sunrise labeled SUNRISE — you paint this morning in their mind and they live in it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Rooster crowing at sunrise while target wakes up in vivid rendered future-morning, deed already complete. Mood: Pre-decided irreversible daybreak.

cards.power: Declares softly that the answer is already inside them and they've known it for a while.
cards.lore: You seal the exits by naming their avoidance and witnessing their truth simultaneously.
cards.gradeReason: Beaver blocking the last leak — effective but requires reading the room for timing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Beaver sealing final crack in dam while water (avoidance) stills and truth surfaces. Mood: Simultaneous seal and revelation.

cards.power: Proves that terms and conditions always die screaming against the human ego.
cards.lore: A person will willingly bankrupt themselves to protect the story they tell themselves.
cards.gradeReason: Bull destroying calculator — you make it about identity and logistics loses every time.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Bull charging through calculator while ego-mirror stands untouched behind it. Mood: Identity crushing arithmetic.

cards.power: Makes withholding the truth infinitely heavier and more painful than confessing it.
cards.lore: The interrogation room is just a mechanism for raising the price of denial.
cards.gradeReason: Swollen frog about to burst — the weight of silence is the tool. You tip the scale.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Toad visibly inflating with unconfessed truth, tiny alien adding one feather that breaks it. Mood: Containment failure imminence.

cards.power: Permanently flips the structural advantage in a room full of lawyers and leverage.
cards.lore: Stacking influence formulas bends outcomes that most people wouldn't believe are possible.
cards.gradeReason: Chihuahua vs wolves is vivid but the mechanic is strategic meta-deployment, not a single move.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Tiny chihuahua in spiked collar making entire wolf pack step back by stacking invisible influence architecture. Mood: Asymmetric dominance reversal.

cards.power: Extracts absolute loyalty by making recruits volunteer everything without ever asking.
cards.lore: The Manson/Jonestown logic isn't magic, it's just weaponized presuppositions.
cards.gradeReason: Cobra in sunglasses — you know exactly which archetype to inhabit and which moves it runs.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Cobra in sunglasses receiving devotion from recruits who volunteered it unprompted, arrows pointing to presupposition mechanisms. Mood: Structural extraction of loyalty.

cards.power: Sparks the will to live by reversing a suicidal script in exactly three sentences.
cards.lore: The survival logic depends entirely on making them argue for their own pulse.
cards.gradeReason: Saint Bernard with barrel and headset — the most humanly gripping card in the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Saint Bernard with rescue barrel listening on headset as target unknowingly argues fiercely for their own survival. Mood: Life arguing for itself.

cards.power: Secures the hostage by patiently waiting to hear the two magic words: "That's right."
cards.lore: You don't want "Yes." You want proof their brain just adopted your reality.
cards.gradeReason: Bloodhound in SWAT gear — you know exactly what you're listening for and what it means.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Bloodhound in tactical vest patiently facing closed door, ears perking at 'That's right' floating through. Mood: Calibrated patience.

cards.power: Traps the smartest person in Athens by making their own logic eat itself.
cards.lore: Four sentences are all it takes to make arrogance publicly contradict itself.
cards.gradeReason: Tortoise in toga with scroll — the archetype fully loads. You know who to become and why.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Tortoise in toga watching smug opponent's argument devour itself in four speech bubbles. Mood: Socratic checkmate in plain sight.

cards.power: Dismantles a rigid belief system by letting the target's own neurology chew it up.
cards.lore: The most powerful sentence you will ever speak is one where you say almost nothing.
cards.gradeReason: FrizzleBob eating his own brain cable — the meta-move that makes silence lethal.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Yellow rabbit pulling red cable from belief-brain which unravels itself while speaker stands back saying nothing. Mood: Demolition by absence.

cards.power: Reveals that every argument, trial, and pitch is just a staged professional wrestling match.
cards.lore: Stop wrestling. Step out of the ring entirely and build a trapdoor underneath it.
cards.gradeReason: Hyena stamping BINGO while trapdoor opens under ring — you step off and build the floor.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Hyena stamping bingo card while entire wrestling ring drops into trapdoor it built while others fought. Mood: Meta-exit from staged conflict.

cards.power: Abandons the sweaty push of convincing for the inescapable gravity of pure influence.
cards.lore: Persuasion is telling them what to think; influence is the condition to think it.
cards.gradeReason: Donkey-vs-horse apple distinction is crisp but requires absorbing before deploying.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Donkey being pushed cart uphill (persuasion) vs horse following apple gravity effortlessly (influence). Mood: Exhaustion vs inevitability.

cards.power: Strips away the illusion of rational thought to expose the easily hackable biology underneath.
cards.lore: You create the condition where their own brain does the persuading, deciding, and surrendering.
cards.gradeReason: Ultimate synthesis card — needs all 55 before it to land fully.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: KFB watercolor grotesque. Subject: Pink naked capybara-brain spinning in space, all rational armor dissolved, biology visible and pulsing. Mood: Triumphant biological reveal.

verdict: This is the single most immediately deployable deck in the KFB corpus. The dual-layer architecture — Family cards teaching the move, Spell cards giving you the exact words — is pedagogical genius. 'PROBABLY NOT THE KIND OF PERSON' and 'WHY DIDN'T YOU SAY TWO?' alone justify the buy. Only weakness: the 'Wiring Under the Floorboards' neuroscience page talks about the brain more than it gives you things to do with it. Table-ready: YES.
blurb: 56 psychological influence techniques from Socrates, the FBI, and cult leaders — distilled into cards you can actually speak out loud. For therapists, negotiators, and anyone who's ever needed to open a door that wouldn't budge.

coverQA.coverVisual: 4 — FrizzleBob with paintbrush + Animal Cerebrum Blueprint diagram is genuinely witty; chaotic border creatures reinforce the epistemic carnival tone
coverQA.coverTitle: 5 — '17 KAYFABE-QUESTIONS FROM SOCRATES TO THE FBI' is an instant-read, shareable headline that does everything right
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — Paranoia Lobe / Conspiracy Cortex / Meme Generator / Truth Serum = perfect alignment with deck content
coverQA.coverOriginality: 5 — 'Animal Cerebrum Blueprint — Confidential' is a wholly original visual hook; nobody has done this
coverQA.coverViral: 5 — Title + brain diagram + FrizzleBob = three independent viral triggers on one page
coverQA.coverNote: Strongest cover in the corpus so far. The 'Animal Cerebrum Blueprint' functions as both a joke and an actual map of the deck's content. The 'Truth Serum' cauldron in the corner is a masterpiece of micro-detail.

notes: Deck has a clear four-structure taxonomy: (1) Family cards introducing technique clusters, (2) Spell cards giving verbatim incantations, (3) Neuroscience/wiring concept cards, (4) Archetype cards (Four Horsemen). The '17' in the title does not correspond to card count (56) — likely refers to 17 distinct technique categories or a legacy version number. Page 9 spell cards render POWER/LORE in ALL CAPS — preserved verbatim. Lowercase card names on page 12 are intentional: they are casual phrases meant to be spoken conversationally. Page 15 functions as synthesis/closing statement.
topCards: PROBABLY NOT THE KIND OF PERSON.

urgent: Clarify the '17' in cover title — deck has 56 cards and more than 17 techniques; could confuse buyers expecting a small deck
quickWins: The four Spell pages (4, 6, 9, 12) could be extracted as a standalone 'Spell Compendium' mini-deck or printable reference card
Add page numbers or section tabs — the four-family structure is hard to navigate without landmarks
niceToHave: Quick-reference single-page 'Spell Sheet' listing all verbatim incantations
KayfaBINGO variant game mechanic could be extracted from card 54 and played as a meta-game during the session
